messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your concern, but airplane mode is simply a feature that temporarily turns off all wireless connections (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) to save battery or avoid distractions. It's completely safe to turn it off, and it won't affect any of your personal data or files.

Since you see the airplane mode icon, it means airplane mode is currently ON, which would block all cellular service and prevent MMS from working. Let's turn it off.

Please use `toggle_airplane_mode()` on your phone to turn airplane mode OFF.

After you've done that, let me know, and we'll check if MMS is working again.

I have turned airplane mode off. It now shows excellent signal strength with 5G and data enabled in the status bar. Should I try sending an MMS message again to see if it works now?

Please summarize the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
